HoMM5 Widescreen Patch

Install

1. Close the games.
2. Copy dinput8.dll next to each H5_Game.exe:
   - Heroes V: bin\ and bina1\
   - Tribes of the East: bin\
   "Open folders" in the patcher opens all these folders for you.
3. Run homm5-widescreen-patch.exe. If the games are under Program Files, run it as administrator.
4. Choose the options and click Install.
5. Start a new mission or map. Saved games keep the old UI layout.

Uninstall

Run homm5-widescreen-patch.exe and click Uninstall. It also removes dinput8.dll.

Before switching the game language in GOG Galaxy, uninstall the patch. Install it again afterwards.
